{{nihongo|'''Taji Shrine'''|多治神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tanba Province]].

'''Taji Shrine''' (たじじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Hiyoshi-cho, {{ill|Nantan, Kyoto|Q170421|qid=Q170421}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
The two principal deities are:
* '''{{ill|Oyamakui no Kami|Q10935105|qid=Q10935105}}'''
* '''{{ill|Futodama|it|Futodama|ja|フトダマ|ru|Футодама|simple|Futodama|zh|布刀玉命|qid=Q11059539|lt=Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto}}'''

=== History ===
Shrine tradition says it was founded in the early {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178}}, during the {{ill|Keiun|ar|فترة كيون|de|Keiun|es|Keiun|fa|کیوئون|fr|Ère Keiun|ia|Keiun|id|Keiun|ja|慶雲|ko|게이운|ru|Кэйун|simple|Keiun|sr|Кеиун|th|เคอุง|tr|Keiun|uk|Кей'ун|zh|慶雲 (日本)|zh_yue|慶雲 (日本)|qid=Q428753}} era (704-707), by Tahara Sadaijin ({{ill|Prince Shiki|de|Shiki no Miko|ja|志貴皇子|ko|시키노미코|zh|志貴皇子|qid=Q11072254}}, also written Shiki no Miko), third imperial son of {{ill|Emperor Tenji|Q314802|qid=Q314802}}<ref>According to ''{{ill|Ruijū Sandai Kyaku|ja|類聚三代格|qid=Q11665185}}''. ''Shoku Nihongi'' entry for Reiki 2, 8th month, 11th day says seventh prince.</ref>.

In the mid-Heian ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'', it is listed as "Tanuma Shrine" in Funai District, {{ill|Tanba Province|Q954511|qid=Q954511}}, and ranked as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}.

Because the settlement name at the shrine site was "Tahara-go," it is thought that the characters "Taji" came to be used, but a ridge tag from {{ill|1302|ab|1302|af|1302|als|1302|am|1302 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1302|ar|1302|ary|1302|arz|1302|ast|1302|avk|1302|az|1302|azb|۱۳۰۲ (میلادی)|bar|1302|be|1302|be_x_old|1302|bg|1302|bn|১৩০২|bpy|মারি ১৩০২|br|1302|bs|1302.|ca|1302|cdo|1302 nièng|ceb|1302|ckb|١٣٠٢|crh|1302|cs|1302|cv|1302|cy|1302|da|1302|de|1302|diq|1302|el|1302|eml|1302|eo|1302|es|1302|et|1302|eu|1302|fa|۱۳۰۲ (میلادی)|fi|1302|fo|1302|fr|1302|frr|1302|fy|1302|ga|1302|gan|1302年|gcr|1302|gd|1302|gl|1302|gv|1302|he|1302|hi|१३०२|hr|1302.|ht|1302 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1302|hy|1302|id|1302|ilo|1302|io|1302|is|1302|it|1302|ja|1302年|jv|1302|ka|1302|kaa|1302|kk|1302 жыл|ko|1302년|ksh|Joohr 1302|la|1302|lb|1302|lij|1302|lmo|1302|lt|1302 m.|lv|1302. gads|mai|१३०२|map_bms|1302|mdf|1302|mg|1302|mhr|1302|mi|1302|min|1302|mk|1302|mr|इ.स. १३०२|mrj|1302 и|ms|1302|my|၁၃၀၂|mzn|۱۳۰۲|nah|1302|nap|1302|nds|1302|nds_nl|1302|new|सन् १३०२|nl|1302|nn|1302|no|1302|nrm|1302|nso|1302|oc|1302|or|୧୩୦୨|os|1302-æм аз|pa|1302|pl|1302|pnb|1302|pt|1302|qu|1302|ro|1302|ru|1302 год|rue|1302|sa|१३०२|sah|1302|scn|1302|sd|1302ع|se|1302|sh|1302.|shn|1302|simple|1302|sk|1302|sl|1302|smn|1302|sq|1302|sr|1302|su|1302|sv|1302|sw|1302|ta|1302|tg|Соли 1302|th|พ.ศ. 1845|tk|1302|tl|1302|tly|1302|tr|1302|tt|1302 ел|uk|1302|ur|1302ء|uz|1302|vec|1302|vi|1302|vls|1302|wa|1302|war|1302|wuu|1302年|xmf|1302|zh|1302年|zh_min_nan|1302 nî|zh_yue|1302年|qid=Q5612}} ({{ill|Kengen|Q1327472|qid=Q1327472|lt=Kengen}} 1) in the Kamakura period reads "Tanuma Daimyojin," suggesting there was also a period when it was called "Tanuma"<ref>''Place Names of Kyoto Prefecture,'' section on Taji Shrine in Funai District.</ref>.

In Meiji 10, it was ranked as {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}} under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}}.

:: Began in {{ill|1414|Q6179|qid=Q6179}} ({{ill|Ōei|Q1193078|qid=Q1193078}} 21), early {{ill|Muromachi period|ar|فترة موروماتشي|ast|Periodu Muromachi|bcl|Panahon nin Muromachi|be|Перыяд Мурамаці|bg|Муромачи|bn|মুরোমাচি যুগ|ckb|سەردەمی مرۆماچی|cs|Období Muromači|de|Muromachi-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Muromaĉi|es|Período Muromachi|eu|Muromachi aroa|fa|دوره موروماچی|fi|Muromachi-kausi|fr|Époque de Muromachi|gl|Período Muromachi|he|תקופת אשיקאגה|hu|Muromacsi-kor|id|Zaman Muromachi|it|Periodo Muromachi|ja|室町時代|ko|무로마치 시대|lt|Muromači laikotarpis|nl|Muromachiperiode|pl|Muromachi (okres)|pt|Período Muromachi|ru|Период Муромати|simple|Muromachi period|sk|Obdobie Muromači|sl|Obdobje Muromači|sr|Муромачи период|sv|Ashikaga|th|ยุคมูโรมาจิ|tl|Panahong Muromachi|tr|Muromachi Dönemi|uk|Період Муроматі|vi|Thời kỳ Muromachi|wuu|室町时代|zh|室町时代|zh_min_nan|Muromati sî-tāi|zh_yue|室町時代|qid=Q334845}}, as a thanksgiving rite for harvest. === Cultural properties ===
See [http://www.kyoto-be.ne.jp/bunkazai/cms/index.php?action=pages_view_mobile&page_id=195&room_id=0&nc_session10=rvufg5qse4mrj5m59igh1q4dd3 "Cultural Properties in Kyoto Prefecture" (Kyoto Prefectural Board of Education, Cultural Properties Division)].

=== Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property (national) ===
* Tahara no Onda - designated in 2000 (Heisei 12)

=== Kyoto Prefecture Designated Intangible Folk Cultural Property ===
* Tahara no Kakkosuri - designated in 1983 (Showa 58)

=== Kyoto Prefecture Registered Cultural Property ===
* Main hall (with 5 ridge tags) - registered in 1985 (Showa 60)

=== Kyoto Prefecture Cultural Property Environment Preservation District ===
* Taji Shrine Cultural Property Environment Preservation District - decided in 1985 (Showa 60)

=== Nantan City Designated Cultural Property ===
* Two mikoshi
: Made in {{ill|1845|Q7636|qid=Q7636}} ({{ill|Kōka|Q1325317|qid=Q1325317}} 2), late {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}}, by Kyoto carpenter Yoshinoya Jinnojō. Designated in 1987 (Showa 62).

=== Site information ===
; Location
* {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}}{{ill|Nantan, Kyoto|Q170421|qid=Q170421}}Hiyoshi-cho Tahara Miyago 2-2

; Access
* Nearest station: {{ill|West Japan Railway Company|Q502125|qid=Q502125|lt=JR West}} {{ill|San'in Main Line|Q1135170|qid=Q1135170}} {{ill|Hiyoshi Station (Kyoto)|Q871551|qid=Q871551|lt=Hiyoshi Station}}; about 15 minutes by Nantan municipal bus or by car

; Nearby
* Kotaji Shrine (Tahara, Hiyoshi-cho, Nantan) - Kakkosuri is dedicated in front of Kotaji Shrine during the Kakkosuri event<ref>[https://tanbarakuichi.sakura.ne.jp/shrine/hiyoshi/03.html#h030 Kotaji Shrine] (Tanba shrines).</ref>
* Taji Shrine (Ikehata, Hiyoshi-cho, Nantan) - enshrined by division from this shrine
